title: Eleven length-22 splits survive, and nine survive the 17-point import
body:
## Summary
- At seven labels, the time bound, odd budget, even budget and pair identity leave 11 splits at length 22.
- The covering floor is 17 points, namely `(10,7)` and `(11,6)`. Importing that exclusion leaves 9.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, no word census, and no `f(7)` claim.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/l22-split-domain/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/l22-split-domain/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/l22-split-domain`
- [ ] Maintainer replay from a clean checkout
